turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting spindle diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Begin with a warm-up run. Bring the spindle up to 50% speed and let it run for 10 minutes.

ground_truth.node_text: Warm up run, spindle at 50% speed for 10 minutes

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Warm-up complete, spindle has been running at 50% for 10 minutes.

ground_truth.node_text: Warm up run, spindle at 50% speed for 10 minutes

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Mount a calibrated accelerometer on the front bearing housing using a flat washer stud or magnetic base. Run the spindle at 3000 RPM with no toolholder fitted and record the RMS vibration velocity in millimeters per second. Then repeat the measurement at maximum rated speed and compare both readings against the ISO 10816 zone limits.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a calibrated accelerometer on the front bearing housing with a flat washer stud or magnetic base. Run the spindle at 3000 revolutions per minute with no toolholder fitted and record the root mean square vibration velocity in millimetres per second. Repeat at the maximum rated speed and compare both readings against the ISO 10816 zone limits for this machine class.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Accelerometer mounted and measurements taken at both speeds. I've recorded the RMS values and compared them to the ISO limits.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a calibrated accelerometer on the front bearing housing with a flat washer stud or magnetic base. Run the spindle at 3000 revolutions per minute with no toolholder fitted and record the root mean square vibration velocity in millimetres per second. Repeat at the maximum rated speed and compare both readings against the ISO 10816 zone limits for this machine class.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the vibration level below the alarm limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Vibration level below alarm limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both readings are comfortably within the acceptable zone.

ground_truth.node_text: Vibration level below alarm limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the bearing temperature within the rated operating limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Bearing temperature within rated operating limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the bearing temperatures are within spec on both the front and rear housings.

ground_truth.node_text: Bearing temperature within rated operating limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the radial runout within 2 micrometer tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Radial runout within 2 µm tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing 3.2 micrometers total indicator reading, which exceeds the 2 micrometer limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Radial runout within 2 µm tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the bearing preload via the locknut in quarter-turn increments.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust bearing pre load via locknut, quarter turn increments

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Preload adjustment made, I've turned the locknut a quarter turn.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust bearing pre load via locknut, quarter turn increments

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the radial runout after the preload adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Still reading 2.8 micrometers, it's improved but still out of specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Perform supplementary bearing preload correction. Disassemble the spindle nose bearing housing, remove the preload spacer, and replace it with a spacer from the next shim increment in the bearing service kit. Reassemble to the specified torque and run the spindle at 1000 RPM for 10 minutes to allow the bearings to seat.

ground_truth.node_text: Supplementary bearing preload correction: disassemble the spindle nose bearing housing, remove the preload spacer, and replace it with a spacer from the next shim increment in the bearing service kit. Reassemble the housing to the specified torque and run the spindle at 1000 revolutions per minute for 10 minutes to allow bearings to seat before returning to the runout measurement step.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Housing disassembled, spacer replaced with the next increment, and reassembled to torque spec. Running at 1000 RPM for seating now.

ground_truth.node_text: Supplementary bearing preload correction: disassemble the spindle nose bearing housing, remove the preload spacer, and replace it with a spacer from the next shim increment in the bearing service kit. Reassemble the housing to the specified torque and run the spindle at 1000 revolutions per minute for 10 minutes to allow bearings to seat before returning to the runout measurement step.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the radial runout after the preload adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Still showing 2.4 micrometers, better but not quite there yet.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Perform supplementary bearing preload correction. Disassemble the spindle nose bearing housing, remove the preload spacer, and replace it with a spacer from the next shim increment in the bearing service kit. ground_truth.node_text: Supplementary bearing preload correction: disassemble the spindle nose bearing housing, remove the preload spacer, and replace it with a spacer from the next shim increment in the bearing service kit. Reassemble the housing to the specified torque and run the spindle at 1000 revolutions per minute for 10 minutes to allow bearings to seat before returning to the runout measurement step.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Second spacer swap complete, housing reassembled and spindle running for another seating cycle.

ground_truth.node_text: Supplementary bearing preload correction: disassemble the spindle nose bearing housing, remove the preload spacer, and replace it with a spacer from the next shim increment in the bearing service kit. turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the radial runout after the preload adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: That did it, now reading 1.6 micrometers, well within tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the axial play within 3 micrometer tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Axial play within 3 µm tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the averaged axial play measurement is 2.1 micrometers, within the 3 micrometer limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Axial play within 3 µm tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the taper contact pattern above 85% bearing area?

ground_truth.node_text: Taper contact pattern above 85% bearing area?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing a spotted pattern with only about 65% blue transfer on the test arbor.

ground_truth.node_text: Taper contact pattern above 85% bearing area?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Clean and reinspect the taper, and check for fretting damage.

ground_truth.node_text: Clean and reinspect taper, check for fretting

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Taper cleaned thoroughly and reinspected, no fretting detected.

ground_truth.node_text: Clean and reinspect taper, check for fretting

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Connect the calibrated pull stud extraction dynamometer to the toolholder retention knob. Apply a steady pull along the spindle axis and record the peak force at which the drawbar releases the toolholder. Compare the result against the minimum drawbar force in the maintenance specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Connect the calibrated pull stud extraction dynamometer to the toolholder retention knob. Apply a steady pull along the spindle axis and record the peak force at which the drawbar releases the toolholder. Compare the result against the minimum drawbar force listed in the spindle maintenance specification; a low reading indicates disc spring wear or stacking loss.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Dynamometer connected and pull test completed. I've recorded the peak release force.

ground_truth.node_text: Connect the calibrated pull stud extraction dynamometer to the toolholder retention knob. Apply a steady pull along the spindle axis and record the peak force at which the drawbar releases the toolholder. Compare the result against the minimum drawbar force listed in the spindle maintenance specification; a low reading indicates disc spring wear or stacking loss.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the drawbar retention force within the rated range?

ground_truth.node_text: Drawbar retention force within rated range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the measured force is about 15% below the minimum specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Drawbar retention force within rated range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the drawbar spring stack or replace the disc springs.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust drawbar spring stack or replace disc springs

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Disc springs replaced with new ones from the service kit.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust drawbar spring stack or replace disc springs

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Mount a dial test indicator against the reference artefact clamped in the spindle at cold start. Zero the indicator and allow the spindle to run at operating speed for 30 minutes. Record the indicator displacement at 10 minute intervals and note the total thermal growth at stabilization. Compare this against the growth compensation value stored in the machine thermal compensation table.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a dial test indicator against the reference artefact clamped in the spindle at cold start. Zero the indicator and allow the spindle to run at operating speed for 30 minutes. Record the indicator displacement at 10 minute intervals and note the total thermal growth value at stabilisation; compare against the growth compensation value stored in the machine thermal compensation table.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Thermal growth test complete. I've logged the displacement values at each interval and compared the final growth to the stored compensation value.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a dial test indicator against the reference artefact clamped in the spindle at cold start. Zero the indicator and allow the spindle to run at operating speed for 30 minutes. Record the indicator displacement at 10 minute intervals and note the total thermal growth value at stabilisation; compare against the growth compensation value stored in the machine thermal compensation table.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the thermal growth within the compensation model tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal growth within compensation model tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the measured thermal growth matches the compensation model within acceptable limits.

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal growth within compensation model tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the spindle speed within plus or minus 0.1% at all test speeds?

ground_truth.node_text: Spindle speed within ±0.1% at all test speeds?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing a 0.3% error at the highest test speed.

ground_truth.node_text: Spindle speed within ±0.1% at all test speeds?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the speed reference gain in the drive parameter.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust speed reference gain in drive parameter

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Speed reference gain adjusted in the controller.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust speed reference gain in drive parameter

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Run the spindle at maximum rated speed with the normal toolholder fitted for five minutes. Record the vibration velocity with the accelerometer on the front bearing housing and compare it against the baseline vibration measurement from the most recent full service.

ground_truth.node_text: Run the spindle at maximum rated speed with the normal toolholder fitted for five minutes. Record vibration velocity with the accelerometer on the front bearing housing and compare against the baseline vibration measurement taken at the same speed during the most recent full service. An increase of more than 30% above baseline requires bearing assessment before releasing the spindle to production.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Final vibration test complete at max speed with toolholder. I've compared the reading to the baseline from the last service.

ground_truth.node_text: Run the spindle at maximum rated speed with the normal toolholder fitted for five minutes. Record vibration velocity with the accelerometer on the front bearing housing and compare against the baseline vibration measurement taken at the same speed during the most recent full service. An increase of more than 30% above baseline requires bearing assessment before releasing the spindle to production.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the final vibration within the warning limit at full speed?

ground_truth.node_text: Final vibration within warning limit at full speed?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the vibration increase is only 18% above baseline, well below the 30% threshold.

ground_truth.node_text: Final vibration within warning limit at full speed?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log all measurements and update the spindle maintenance record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log all measurements and update spindle maintenance record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All measurements logged and maintenance record updated in the system.

ground_truth.node_text: Log all measurements and update spindle maintenance record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. The spindle has passed all diagnostic checks and is cleared for production.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, procedure complete.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete
